judgment_text:
PRAYER : Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS, 2023, to direct the Honourable Special Court for Trail of Cases under SC and ST (POA) act, Kallakurichi to accept the surrender of the petitioners and to consider the bail petition on the same day in Crime No. 143 of 2026 on the file of the 2nd respondent police.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

L. Victoria Gowri, J.:— This Criminal Original Petition has been filed seeking to direct the Honourable Special Court for Trail of Cases under SC and ST (POA) act, Kallakurichi to accept the surrender of the petitioners and to consider the bail petition on the same day in Crime No. 143 of 2026 on the file of the 2nd respondent police.

2. Considering the nature of the relief sought for, notice to the 3rd respondent is dispensed with.

3. The case of the prosecution is that the petitioner abused the defacto complainant using caste-based words, attacked him thereby causing injuries and threatened him. Based on these allegations, an FIR has been registered against the petitioner.

4. Heard the learned counsel on either side and carefully perused the materials available on record.

5. Considering the limited scope of the relief sought for, this Court hereby direct the learned Judge, Special Court for SC/ST, Kallakurichi District to issue prior notice to the de facto complainant and thereafter, to consider the bail application of the petitioner on the same day of his surrender before that Court in connection with Crime No. 143 of 2026 on the file of the 2nd respondent police. The petitioner shall surrender before the learned trial court within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

6. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
